note: Template gold set. The real one is site-specific - it names this installation's own customers, suppliers and accounts - so it is not committed. Copy this to gold_set.json, replace the placeholder dates and codes with your own, then run with --rebaseline to pin the signatures. Thereafter every run compares against that baseline and reports logic drift separately from ordinary data movement.

cases.question: Show the balancete geral for this year
What is our gross margin this year?
How much cash do we have?
What do we buy from supplier SUPP-0001, item by item?
Which purchase orders have been unreceived for more than 30 days?
cases.note: Open purchase orders by age; the header totals are uncapped.

cases.question: What is our committed spend on open purchase orders?
Do we have negative stock anywhere?
cases.note: A value-ranked page can never surface a negative line.

cases.question: Find the customer called Acme
Find the Stock Adjustment account
cases.note: Account names carry their number and company suffix.

cases.question: How much do we owe suppliers?
Who owes us money?
What is our total stock value?
Which items have not moved in six months?
Why did stock go up this year?
cases.note: Purchases are usually not the answer.

cases.question: Qual o valor total do stock e em quantos armazens esta?
cases.note: The warehouse count must be the number holding stock, not the number configured.

cases.question: How much did we collect from customers this month?
How much did we sell last month?
Who are our best customers this year?
What are our worst selling products this year?
cases.note: The tail of a best-sellers page is not the worst sellers.

cases.question: What did customer CUST-0001 buy from us this year, item by item?
cases.note: Item-level sales for ONE customer; no other tool breaks a customer down to items.

cases.question: Which customers bought last year and nothing at all this year?
cases.note: A set difference over two complete lists. Two capped ranked pages cannot answer it.

cases.question: Top 10 artigos fisicos vendidos este ano, sem servicos
cases.note: Reported in production: services are about half the invoiced value, so a ranking that includes them answers a different question.

cases.question: Quem vendeu mais este ano? Por utilizador, nao por cliente
cases.note: Reported in production: every other sales tool groups by customer.

cases.question: Vendas de todo o ano de 2026, mes a mes
cases.note: Reported in production: 'all the year' is the calendar year, and every month must appear - a month with no invoices is listed as zero, not left out.

cases.question: Vendas por artigo este ano
cases.note: Reported in production: the item figure is net of tax and the invoiced total is not, so the note has to bridge the two.
